summary: Tested W5 (Surat Jalan CMT PDF) and W3 (Stock Thresholds / Alert Stok) end-to-end. 13/13 backend API tests pass. Full UI flow validated: Surat Jalan button + column picker dialog on 'Terima FG dari CMT' opens with 7/10 columns pre-checked (No, Serial No, SKU, Nama Produk, Size, Warna, Qty Kirim); QC columns (Qty Terima, Qty Reject, Keterangan) unchecked by default; No & Qty Kirim marked 'wajib'. PDF export API works for default + narrow cols; SJ-CMT number is idempotent per receipt; error handling correct (400 missing id, 404 unknown id, 401 no auth). Ambang Stok tab shows 333 materials with 4 summary cards + empty warning + filters + apply-all + selective use-suggestion buttons. Filling 6000 on ACC-BTN-12 (stok 5000) then saving increased 'Sudah punya ambang' to 1 and 'Stok kritis' to 1; alert appeared correctly on Alert & Reorder as '1 Kritis' with detail 'Stok Kancing bulat plastik (5000 pcs) di bawah ambang 6000 pcs — kurang 1000'; notice + goto-thresholds link present. Data cleaned up (thresholds restored to 0/0, missing_threshold back to 333/333).

issues: Direct hash navigation to '#wh-smart' from another warehouse route does not switch view — URL stays as previously active hash (e.g. #wh-master) when the sidebar 'Alert & Reorder' link is clicked. Not a functional bug (sidebar works via click), but the review-request's claim of 'hash route #wh-smart' is misleading. Consider aligning hash to actual route.

critical_code_review_comments: PdfColumnPicker defaults for cmt-delivery-note (SJ_DEFAULT_COLS) correctly enforce owner rule: QC-related columns must be manually opted-in.
backend/core/cmt_delivery_note.ensure_number() confirmed idempotent via PDF text extraction (same SJ-CMT number across 2 calls).
StockThresholdsModule uses a single global 'threshold-save' button, not per-row. Not a bug, but review request suggested per-row testid convention; document accordingly.
warehouse/alerts metadata correctly exposes materials_missing_threshold + materials_total; UI 'wh-smart-threshold-notice' renders honestly.
seed_data_creation: None. Threshold on ACC-BTN-12 was temporarily set to 6000 for W3-3/W3-4 verification then reset to 0 (verified summary returned to 0/333/0/0). One cmt_delivery_notes doc was created for receipt CMT-RCV-00001 during PDF idempotency test — this is expected per review-request guidance ('itu wajar, jangan dihapus manual').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Global save button is `threshold-save` (single button reflecting pending changes count e.g. 'Simpan (1)'), NOT per-row `threshold-save-<KODE>`. When navigating warehouse sub-modules programmatically prefer clicking sidebar text (e.g., page.get_by_text('Alert & Reorder')) rather than setting `location.hash='#wh-smart'` — hash routing to smart module is unreliable when already inside warehouse portal.
